Note.title: Note
Note.description: A user-authored note supporting rich text/markdown, folder assignment, archive, trash soft-delete, version history snapshots, category tagging, custom reminder notifications, offline sync, and optional password encryption.

userId.description: The UID of the authenticated Google user who owns this note.

title.description: The title of the note (up to 200 characters).

content.description: The plain text body of the note, or a placeholder when locked (up to 20000 characters).

folderId.description: ID of the folder this note belongs to, or empty string if unfiled (up to 128 characters).

tags.description: Bounded list of up to 10 string tags associated with the note.

colorHex.description: Optional accent color identifier for the note card (up to 20 characters).

isPinned.description: Whether the note is pinned to the top of the workspace.

isArchived.description: Whether the note is archived out of the main workspace.

isTrashed.description: Whether the note is in the Trash Bin awaiting restore or permanent deletion.

trashedAtEpochMillis.description: Epoch timestamp in milliseconds when the note was moved to Trash, or 0 if active.

passwordHash.description: SHA-256 salted verification hash for unlocking the sensitive note (up to 256 characters).

encryptedPayload.description: AES-GCM encrypted note body when isLocked is true (up to 30000 characters).

reminderEpochMillis.description: Scheduled push notification epoch timestamp in milliseconds, or 0 if none.

reminderLabel.description: Custom reminder notification note/label (up to 100 characters).

versionHistory.description: Bounded list of up to 10 serialized revision snapshots for version history recovery.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the note was created. Clients must submit FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the note was last modified. Clients must submit FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

Category.title: Category
Category.description: A user-defined custom category/tag group for organizing notes.

userId.description: The UID of the authenticated user who owns this category.

name.description: Display name of the category (1 to 40 characters).

colorHex.description: Color identifier for the category badge (up to 20 characters).

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the category was created. Clients must submit FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

Folder.title: Folder
Folder.description: A user-defined folder for hierarchical organization of notes, supporting create, rename, move (nested parent folder), and delete.

userId.description: The UID of the authenticated user who owns this folder.

name.description: Display name of the folder (1 to 60 characters).

parentFolderId.description: ID of the parent folder, or empty string if at root level (up to 128 characters).

colorHex.description: Accent color identifier for the folder icon/badge (up to 20 characters).

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the folder was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the folder was last renamed or moved.
